stories.headline: Xbox checks 70+ Entra tenants with Maester, every night.
stories.summary: Xbox Security grades a gaming-specific Entra baseline of about 50 controls in every game studio's tenant, from one GitHub Actions pipeline. Audrey Long, Principal Cloud Security Architect in Xbox Security, explained how on Entra.Chat.

stories.quote: So every night for all 70 of my tenants, I'm running all my Maester tests.
quotes: The reports that I give to my studios, I have got nothing but amazing feedback on them.
